comments.text:
This Cuba documentary follows families stretching a ration book, keeping 70-year-old cars alive, and living through sudden blackouts 💡🚗. But the part that surprised us most wasn't the hardship. It was what Cubans built in spite of it.
👇 If you had to live there for one year, which would be harder for you? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for more real life stories like this one.
#Cuba #CubaDocumentary #LifeInCuba
